Messages.Author: Stefan
Messages.Body:
If Kamiri wa Itherero is blocked by an ally and that ally burns at the end of the action because of Kamiri's special - is Kamiri considered to have burned that ally?

Kamiri wa Itherero [LoB:PA2]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Akunanse
Group: 4
Capacity: 10
Discipline:pot qui ABO ANI FOR OBF
Laibon: Younger vampires must burn 1 blood to attempt to block Kamiri. If an ally blocks Kamiri and combat occurs, burn the ally at the end of the action.

www.lordoftheclog.blogspot.com

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Stefan wrote:
> If Kamiri wa Itherero is blocked by an ally and that ally burns at the end of the action because of Kamiri's special - is Kamiri considered to have burned that ally?
>
Yes, but not as a  action (whatever the action was) nor in combat.  [LSJ 20050328]
